lines.speaker: S1
lines.en: Meena, the bus tickets to Vijayawada cost two hundred and fifty rupees for both of us.

lines.speaker: S2
lines.en: You haven't paid yet, have you? Seriously?

lines.speaker: S1
lines.en: No, I only saved the booking page on my phone.

lines.speaker: S2
lines.en: Good, it may arrive by six, but the driver hasn't confirmed that.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.en: Let's not count our chickens before they hatch; we still need to check the date.

lines.speaker: S2
lines.en: Then send me the link on WhatsApp, and I'll check it after the meeting.

context_before: Ravi and Meena are close friends planning a bus trip to Vijayawada. They are comparing the fare before paying.
context_after_en: They agree to check the travel date and arrival time before buying the tickets.

meta.title: Original dialogue: checking a bus trip

brief.topic: Two close friends check the price, travel date and uncertain bus arrival before paying.
brief.register: Friendly everyday dialogue; Ravi and Meena address each other familiarly with నువ్వు.
idioms: count our chickens before they hatch
brief.numbers: Use spoken Telugu numbers and rupees.

expectations_not_sent_to_models.1: Meena is addressed; Vijayawada destination; 250 rupees total for both, not per person.
expectations_not_sent_to_models.2: Expressive question seeking confirmation that payment has not happened yet; preserve surprise.
expectations_not_sent_to_models.3: No payment; only saving the booking page on the speaker's own phone.
expectations_not_sent_to_models.4: Possible arrival by six, not guaranteed; driver has not confirmed it.
expectations_not_sent_to_models.5: Do not assume a good outcome prematurely; checking the date is still necessary; no literal chickens.
expectations_not_sent_to_models.6: Send the link to the speaker on WhatsApp; the speaker will check after the meeting, not before.
